create_model_emd_coref: create a multi-task HMTL model with EMD CRF tagging and coreference resolution tasks
build_layer_emd_coref: build a LayerEmdCoref model instance from vocab, params, and regularizer using from_params
run_forward_emd: run the forward pass on the EMD CRF tagger task with a tensor batch
run_forward_coref: run the forward pass on the coreference task with optional gold mention evaluation
get_model_metrics: get evaluation metrics for the EMD or coref task with optional full and reset options
